text:
sarah (People Ops): Quick heads-up @here — launching a 6-month pilot starting 2026-05-01: +3 "Mental Health Days" (separate from PTO) and a one-time Emergency Care Stipend ($500) for urgent caregiver/childcare/medical travel. More below. :sparkles:

ana (People Ops): Who's eligible? Full-time only or all regular employees?

sarah (People Ops): Open to all regular employees (FT and part-time working 20+ hrs/wk) globally. Contractors excluded for this pilot. Manager approval required for MH Days; stipend is reimbursable (receipts) or can be advanced in emergencies.

jordan (Eng): Nice — does MH Days reduce accruals or count against wellness bank?

sarah (People Ops): These are additive: MH Days are distinct and do NOT reduce PTO or wellness days. Think of them as short, supported mental health leave for acute needs.

mike (CTO): Huge +1. Please add a note for eng leads about IRL on-call coverage when people take MH Days.

leah (Manager): Can managers deny a request? What's the expected turnaround?

ana (People Ops): Managers should approve within 48 hours unless there's a major scheduling conflict — then discuss alternatives with the employee. Denials should be rare; escalate to People Ops for support.

leah (Manager): Got it, thank you. Is the stipend limited to certain expense types?

sarah (People Ops): Stipend intended for short-term childcare, emergency travel, or urgent care-related costs. Submit receipts in Expensify (tag "MH-Stipend"). If no receipts are available (e.g., last-minute travel), managers can request an advance via the People Ops form.

hr-bot: Policy doc updated: https://docs.redwood.company/people-ops/mental-health-pilot — v1.0 (published 2026-05-01).

jordan (Eng): Will this show up in the UI for time-off requests or do we just use the existing PTO flow?

ana (People Ops): We added a separate request type in the time-off form: select "Mental Health Day (Pilot)". For stipend, use the new expense category. Instructions and sample manager responses are in the doc.

sarah (People Ops): We'll track uptake, stipend usage, and manager feedback. Pilot review scheduled for 2026-11-01 — we'll share metrics and decide next steps. If you have edge cases (international payroll, visa constraints), DM me or ping #help-people-ops. :heart:

mike (CTO): Thanks team — can we also add this to new-hire onboarding so folks know up front?

ana (People Ops): Yep, adding to onboarding checklist and the People Ops FAQ.

jordan (Eng): Saved the doc. Appreciate this.

sarah (People Ops): Thanks all — reach out with questions.
